notes.title: Soldiers: Heroes of World War II Has Earned Its Enhanced Edition Status!
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!

As many of you already know, Soldiers: Heroes of World War II recently received a major update that breathed new life into the classic title, making it fully compatible with modern systems. It brought a wide range of improvements, including native widescreen support, upscaled graphics in up to 4K resolution, streamlined multiplayer through Steam, and many other enhancements designed to modernize the original experience.

And thanks to the overwhelmingly positive response from you – our dedicated players – and after thorough testing and proper bug-squashing, we’re proud to officially declare that the game now deserves to be given the status of [b]Enhanced Edition[/b]!

To recap for those who may have missed it, here are the most important additions introduced in this update:

[list]
[*] Native 4K resolution support, widescreen compatibility, and enhanced UI upscaling for HDPI displays while rendering the 3D scene at native resolution.
[*] Full compatibility with Windows 10 and 11.
[*] Updated and enhanced Editor – create new maps or modify existing missions.
[*] Steam Workshop support to ease the distribution of community-generated content, including maps, missions, and mods.
[*] Steam multiplayer network integration, providing seamless access to both vanilla and modded lobbies for PvP and co-op sessions with friends.
[*] Integration of Steam achievements and community items.
[*] Enhanced multi-core CPU support, improved overall stability, memory leak fixes, and various other technical optimizations.
[/list]
In case you’d like to dive deeper, we encourage you to check out the full changelog in our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/11480/view/761771660008227128]update announcement[/url]. You can also find more details in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/11480]recent Steam News posts[/url], where we’ve covered other follow-up patches and updates.

We want to say a huge thank you to everyone who has already joined us on this journey. These improvements wouldn’t have been possible without your continued support, feedback, and enthusiasm, and we’re incredibly grateful for it.

If you haven’t shared your thoughts yet, we’d love to hear from you! Feel free to leave a review here on Steam or join the conversation in the Discussions. You’re also very welcome to become part of our growing community on [url=https://discord.gg/WSAuGtWHBf]Best Way’s official Discord server[/url].

See you on the battlefield, Commanders!

notes.title: The Achievement Overhaul & A Little Extra (update R1.28.7)
notes.content:
Greetings, community members!

Since launching the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/11480/view/501691675000700944?l=english]community items and achievements[/url], we’ve been closely watching your feedback. While most achievements worked fine, some… well, they had a mind of their own!

We knew we had to act fast, so our first step was a hotfix to address a major issue preventing achievements from registering properly. That quick fix helped, but as we soon found out… this old game kicks us hard!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953520/d61e0c5569846aeb9ad4e10575a80e6975857c8f.png[/img]
[h2]Hunting Down Achievement Bugs—One by One![/h2]
To get a complete picture, we rolled up our sleeves and tested all 72 achievements from top to bottom. This wasn’t just about making sure they function correctly—we also wanted to evaluate their difficulty, and overall experience.

After compiling our results, we combined them with your valuable feedback to pinpoint the biggest issues. Then, one of our game designers took on the task of rewriting and refining mission scripts to fix and improve achievement logic.

Once that was done, we ran another round of testing—this time with the help of our amazing community members! The results? Single-player achievements were finally working as intended. But we weren’t stopping there.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953520/e401f7d54b610a1e34cd320cb1e3c9f43dc94973.png[/img]
[h2]Fully Fixed Achievements in Co-op[/h2]
Next, we turned our attention to co-op mode. We knew this would be a challenge, so after making the necessary fixes, we performed two more rounds of tests with the help of our dedicated testers. And yes… we reset our achievements twice to ensure every fix worked properly. It was painful, but totally worth it!

Now, we’re happy to report that all achievements are fully functional in both single-player and cooperative modes! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953520/cb626a4c2a3a22fea9f738d9266af61d1cd9873d.png[/img]
[h2]A Little Extra: Bug Fixes & Fresh Tunes[/h2]
While working on achievements, we also took the opportunity to squash a few extra bugs and add music to four bonus missions. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953520/9129eaba98789cc8c31d6ce671684a7069a7a8b3.png[/img]
[h2]A Heartfelt Thank You![/h2]
This update wouldn’t have been possible without our passionate and dedicated community, especially our tester! Your feedback, patience, and support helped us fine-tune the experience, and we’re beyond grateful for all the help we received. This game is a labor of love, and it’s truly a team effort!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953520/c5f8d581a8d6351ee781f46855f09981bd1a7ffb.png[/img]
[h2]Did you know?[/h2]
[list]
[*] We’re already working on the next update, with even more bug fixes and improvements on the way!
[*] We hold [b]Weekly Contests[/b] on [url=https://discord.gg/WSAuGtWHBf]Best Way Discord[/url]!
[*] We have an active community, and you can find players for both vanilla and modded sessions on [url=https://discord.gg/WSAuGtWHBf]Best Way Discord[/url].
[/list]
[url=https://discord.gg/WSAuGtWHBf][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3953520/70b257ddae3ca059abe61c9844d84edb9a35f5ba.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]Full Change Log:[/h2]
[b]Highlights[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved achievement logic for both single-player and cooperative modes.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing achievements from registering correctly.
[*] Fixed and enhanced the achievement logic of 15 missions.
[*] Added music to 4 bonus missions
[/list]
[b]General Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the Churchill Mark IV armor could be penetrated by small arms fire.
[/list]
[b]Missions[/b]
[list]
[*] Added music to the following missions:
[list]
[*] Save & Attack
[*] Defensive
[*] Train
[*] Convoy
[/list]
[*] Resolved a bug that allowed player-controlled vehicles to have unlimited ammo and fuel in two bonus missions.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Fuel Truck failed to explode in the Shooting Range mission.
[/list]
[b]Achievements[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved achievement logic for both single-player and cooperative modes.
[*] Fixed an issue preventing achievements from registering correctly.
[*] Fixed and enhanced achievement logic for the following:
[list]

notes.title: Community Items and Achievements are Live Now!
notes.content:
Greetings, Commanders!

As a follow-up to the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/11480/allnews/]recent updates[/url] to Soldiers: Heroes of World War II, we are beyond excited to announce that we've now added [b]Steam achievements[/b] to the game as well!

And since we know we have a lot of collectors among us, we're adding tons of [b]Steam community items too[/b]. That means you're now able to earn [b]Trading Cards, Profile Backgrounds, Badges and Emoticons[/b]! Some of these can be earned naturally by playing the game or traded with other Commanders, and some can be bought for Steam points on the Steam market. You can check examples below the article.

We also wanted to share a heartfelt message directly from the developers at [url=https://discord.com/invite/Dnqp6GGwGj]Best Way[/url], who have poured their passion into the new updates:

[i]"Soldiers: Heroes of World War II has always held a special place in our hearts, and we know it does for many of you as well. For countless players, it serves as a cherished childhood memory, reminding us of the excitement of developing our very first game.

Over the past 20 years, the gaming landscape has undergone significant changes. Various online multiplayer services have shut down, Steam has risen to prominence as a key platform, and new operating systems have emerged. In light of this evolution and our fond memories of the dedicated community surrounding Soldiers, we felt a strong urge to revisit this beloved classic.

Best Way took the initiative to fund and develop the new updates as a token of our gratitude to all of you, our loyal players who have stood by us through thick and thin. We also wish to thank Fulqrum Publishing for helping us to release these updates on Steam.

These patches are a true labor of love for everyone at Best Way. Our heartfelt hope is that these improvements allow you to relive those cherished nostalgic moments while experiencing Soldiers: Heroes of World War II in a refreshed and enhanced way. Enjoy the journey!"[/i]

In case you want to try other Men of War games, be sure to check out the most recent addition to the franchise, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128860/Men_of_War_II/]Men of War II[/url], and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/12621/Men_of_War_Classic_Collection/]Men of War: Classic Collection[/url] bundle that includes all the Men of War games and their DLCs. There is also an additional discount of the bundle that you can use simply to complete your set, you don't have to re-buy the games you already own!

To join Best Way's Discord, please, [url=https://discord.com/invite/Dnqp6GGwGj]follow this link[/url].

Not long ago, we [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/11480/view/761771660008227128]released the first patch for Soldiers: Heroes of World War II, which includes compatibility with Windows 10 and 11, fixes to the occasional memory leaks[/url], and many more. However, we want you to be able to play the game as smoothly as possible, so we prepared another open beta update!

[b]Why an Open Beta?[/b]
The new update is a small but important fix for Soldiers: Heroes of World War II. There are many new or changed features and content to experience, and even though we have tested it thoroughly, we would still like to get feedback from you, our fans, and Men of War series enthusiasts to see if we missed anything that needs to be fixed or improved before we roll it out for everyone. If you decide to help us and try it out, please let us know what you think about the update here in the comments or in [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/11480/discussions/]Steam Discussions[/url][/b].

[b]How to access the update beta?[/b]
It's very simple. Go to your Steam library and find Soldiers: Heroes of World War II, right-click on the title, select Properties => Betas, and in the drop-down menu labeled Beta Participation, select "patch_beta". Your game will update, and that's it. You can opt out of the beta at any point: just follow choose NONE in the beta selection menu.

notes.title: 20 years later, classic RTS game gets transformed by surprise Steam update
notes.content:
World War II and RTS games have always gone together perfectly. We've got Company of Heroes, Men of War, and Steel Division 2 to name a few. Back in 2004, however, we had Soldiers: Heroes of World War II. This epochal strategy game helped pioneer the modern RTS as we know it today, but in the last 20 years, it's gone largely unloved. Until now that is. Both Best Way and Fulqrum Publishing have just released a game-changing and modernizing update for Soldiers: Heroes of World War II, making the last two decades seem like nothing.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Men of War II Multiplayer Tech Test - Jump Into the Action NOW!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=SoFqHkgl93U;full][/previewyoutube]

Announced during the Future Games Show: Spring Showcase, the multiplayer tech test is the first time Men of War II is publicly playable and will run until Monday, March 27 (10 am PDT / 1 pm EDT / 5 pm UTC). The test features four multiplayer modes (of seven that will feature in the full game) and five varied maps, in addition to a set of nine single player tutorial missions that will take you from the basics through to advanced gameplay mechanics and systems.

[b]Enlisting in the tech test is simple; you just need to head over to the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128860/Men_of_War_II/]Men of War II Steam store page[/url] where you will have the option to ‘Request Access’ for a Men of War II Playtest - doing so will grant instant access to "Men of War II Playtest" in your Steam Library.[/b]

Once installed, you can battle it out in 1v1 up to 5v5 matchups via custom lobbies or PvP matchmaking. A lobby allows full control over the game mode, map selection and team sizes, as well as private, password protected lobbies. Matchmaking however will automatically group players by their real-world location and ranking based on their past games, and set them up in Front Line mode.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1128860/Men_of_War_II/

You will be able to choose from the 1st Infantry, 1st Tank or 1st Artillery battalion from the Soviet, German and U.S. armies, allowing you to try out over 80 units from the full game’s total roster of over 300. Each battalion features its own gameplay style and unique strategic opportunities resulting in a deeply rewarding experience that is easy to pick up, but difficult to master. Furthermore, the full game will feature individual battalion customisation and additional unit unlocks via in-game progression, expanding the level of control players have on the battlefield.

The tech test includes only a small sample of the content Men of War II will feature on release, but already proves the depth and variety of gameplay and dedication to historical accuracy that will make it the most immersive depiction of World War II battles in franchise history. It will feature 22 multiplayer maps when it launches later this year.

[b][h3]The four multiplayer modes available during the tech test are as follows:[/h3][/b]

[b]Combat[/b] - a classic Men of War mode featuring an all-out brawl between two teams. Victory goes to the team that can destroy the most enemy units, while keeping their own most valuable units alive. (Available on the Borovaya River and The Winter March maps).

[b]Assault Zones[/b] - opposing players go head-to-head to earn victory points by capturing and holding strategic points on the map. (Available on the Bazerville and Borovaya River maps).

[b]Front Line[/b] - a brand new, strategic mode, that sees teams using infantry to push their Front Line into enemy territory resulting in a tense tug-of-war style match-up in which teamwork is paramount. (Available on all five maps).

[b]Incursion[/b] - an asymmetric game mode utilising the Front Line mechanic, in which one team needs to capture a number of highlighted zones held by the opposing team. (Only available on The Coast map).

[b][h3]The following five maps in the tech test:[/h3][/b]

[b]Bazerville[/b] - a map with very little elevation, easy to navigate, open terrain, only sporadically peppered with lone buildings. Ideal for long-range fighting or exploiting weaknesses with fast-moving units.

[b]Borovaya River[/b]  - a very rugged map, featuring many hills and valleys in its terrain. The map is split in half by a large river, giving players many tactical options to try out and experiment with.

[b]Farmland[/b] - a complex map that at first glance seems deceptively simple due to its flat terrain with no elevation to speak of. This rural environment features many farmsteads and even greenhouse buildings, as well as deep ponds with narrow crossings, creating natural chokepoints for heavy vehicles.

[b]The Coast[/b] - while there is no naval combat present in Men of War II, in this map the sea plays a role, as it takes a significant part of the map, leaving a narrow strip of flat, level land to fight over.

[b]The Winter March[/b] - set in harsh winter conditions, this map combines rolling countryside terrain features with many village buildings showcasing the destructible environment elements of Men of War II and forcing players to utilise smart positioning to get a clear line of fire on their enemies.

[b]Men of War II will be available for PC in 2023. [/b]
